title: Adolescence: A Stage of Growth and Change

learn.hook: Have you noticed that some classmates suddenly look taller after the summer holidays? Welcome to the growth spurt!
points: Adolescence is the stage of life between childhood and adulthood, the teenage years. The body and mind both change.
Puberty is the time when the body starts changing towards an adult body. It is controlled by hormones, chemical messengers made in the body.
Common changes: a sudden increase in height (growth spurt), new hair growth, more sweat and oil, and a changing voice.

In boys the voice box grows and the voice becomes deeper; it may crack for a while. A bump in the throat called the Adam's apple may show. In girls, the body shape changes and periods (menstruation) begin, which is a normal, healthy process.
Changes start at different ages for different people. Girls often begin a little earlier than boys. All of this is normal.

example.q: Aman is shorter than most of his friends in Class 7 and feels worried. What would you tell him?
steps: Puberty and the growth spurt start at different ages in different people.
Many children grow quickly a little later.
Height also depends on family genes, food, sleep and exercise.
example.answer: There is no need to worry: everyone has their own timing, and eating well, sleeping well and staying active help growth.

learn.reallife: Doctors and school health check-ups track height and weight to make sure children are growing in a healthy way.

games.title: Puberty facts
items: Puberty changes are controlled by hormones.
Hormones are chemical messengers that tell the body to start these changes.
Everyone starts puberty at exactly the same age.
The timing is different for each person, and that is normal.
Sweat and oil glands become more active during puberty.
That is why pimples and body odour can appear, and keeping clean matters more.
A boy's voice may crack for a while as his voice box grows.
The voice box grows and the voice settles into a deeper tone.
Menstruation is a sign of illness.
Periods are a normal, healthy part of growing up for girls.

games.title: Who usually notices this change?
items: Growth spurt in height
Pimples due to oily skin
New hair under the arms
Voice becomes much deeper
Adam's apple may show
Beard and moustache grow
Periods begin

quiz.q: What is adolescence?
options: The stage of life between childhood and adulthood
quiz.explain: Adolescence covers the teenage years when a child grows into an adult.
quiz.mistake: Does not know the meaning of the word

quiz.q: What controls the changes of puberty?
quiz.explain: Hormones are chemical messengers made by glands in the body. They start and guide the changes of puberty.
quiz.mistake: Does not know that chemical messengers drive body changes

quiz.q: A sudden increase in height during puberty is called:
quiz.explain: Many adolescents grow taller quickly over a short time. This is the growth spurt.
quiz.mistake: Mixes up the names of puberty changes

quiz.q: Why does a boy's voice become deeper during puberty?
quiz.explain: The voice box (larynx) grows larger, which makes the voice deeper. It may crack for a while.
quiz.mistake: Believes a myth about why voices change

quiz.q: Why do many teenagers get pimples?
options: Oil glands in the skin become more active
quiz.explain: During puberty the skin makes more oil, which can block tiny pores and cause pimples.
quiz.mistake: Blames a single food instead of the body's changes

quiz.q: Riya's friend has begun her periods and is scared. What is correct?
options: She should stop going to school
Periods are a normal, healthy part of growing up
Only some unlucky girls have periods
quiz.explain: Menstruation is a natural monthly process in girls' bodies after puberty begins. She can talk to a trusted adult.
quiz.mistake: Thinks a normal body change is an illness

quiz.q: Do all children begin puberty at the same age?
options: No, the timing is different for each person
quiz.explain: Puberty can start earlier or later. Girls often start a little before boys.
quiz.mistake: Expects everyone's body to follow one fixed timetable

quiz.q: Which change happens to both boys and girls during puberty?
options: New hair grows under the arms
quiz.explain: Underarm hair grows in both. A very deep voice and a beard are mostly seen in boys; periods happen in girls.
quiz.mistake: Does not separate common changes from changes seen mostly in one group

teach.ask: Gappu's older cousin is suddenly tall and has a new deep voice! What is happening to him? Is it normal?
teach.praise: Tweet! Hormones bring changes at puberty, and everyone has their own timing. Totally normal!
teach.nudge: What inside the body starts these changes?

learn.hook: Your body is like a new phone getting a big update during adolescence. It needs the right care to run smoothly!
points: More sweat and oil means you should bathe daily, wear clean, washed clothes and keep your hair clean.
Wash your face gently to help with pimples. Do not squeeze them, as this can cause marks and infection.
Girls should use clean sanitary pads or clean cloth during periods, change them regularly, and wrap and throw them in a dustbin.
Eat a balanced diet: proteins for growth, calcium (milk, curd, ragi) for bones, and iron (green leafy vegetables, jaggery, pulses) for healthy blood.
Get enough sleep, play or exercise every day, and drink plenty of water. Avoid too much junk food and fizzy drinks.

example.q: Kavya has started her periods and feels very tired. Her doctor says she needs more iron. Which tiffin is better: chips and a cold drink, or a roti with palak dal and a few dates?
steps: Iron is needed to make healthy blood, and some blood is lost during periods.
Palak (spinach), dal and dates contain iron.
Chips and cold drinks give little iron or other nutrients.
example.answer: The roti with palak dal and dates is better, because it gives iron and other nutrients.

learn.reallife: Under a government health programme, many schools in India give adolescents weekly iron and folic acid tablets, because iron is so important at this age.

games.title: Healthy habit or not?
items: Bathing every day
Eating green leafy vegetables
Playing outdoors daily
Sleeping enough at night
Changing sanitary pads regularly
Squeezing pimples
Wearing the same socks for days
Skipping breakfast every day
Eating chips instead of meals

games.title: Match the nutrient to its job
pairs: Growth and repair of the body
Keeps the body cool and hydrated

quiz.q: Why should adolescents bathe every day?
options: Sweat and oil increase, and germs can cause body odour
quiz.explain: Sweat glands work more during adolescence. Daily bathing keeps the skin clean and fresh.
quiz.mistake: Does not link bathing with more sweat during puberty

quiz.q: Which food is a good source of calcium?
quiz.explain: Milk, curd, paneer and ragi are rich in calcium, which builds strong bones.
quiz.mistake: Does not know which foods give calcium

quiz.q: Iron in food helps the body to:
quiz.explain: Iron is needed to make haemoglobin, which carries oxygen in blood.
quiz.mistake: Mixes up the jobs of different nutrients

quiz.q: Which is the right thing to do about pimples?
options: Wash the face gently and not squeeze them
quiz.explain: Squeezing can cause infection and marks. Gentle washing keeps pores clean.
quiz.mistake: Thinks squeezing pimples helps

quiz.q: What is a correct practice during periods?
options: Use the same pad all day and night
Change sanitary pads or cloth regularly and throw used pads wrapped in a dustbin
Throw used pads into the toilet
quiz.explain: Changing regularly prevents infection. Wrapped disposal in a bin keeps surroundings clean.
quiz.mistake: Believes myths about hygiene during periods

quiz.q: Which of these foods is rich in iron?
quiz.explain: Palak, methi, other green leafy vegetables, jaggery, dates and pulses provide iron.
quiz.mistake: Does not know iron sources

quiz.q: Why is a balanced diet very important during adolescence?
options: The body is growing fast and needs many nutrients
quiz.explain: Rapid growth needs proteins, vitamins, minerals and energy from a variety of foods.
quiz.mistake: Thinks diet does not matter while growing

quiz.q: Which daily habit helps both the body and the mind stay healthy?
options: Sitting with a phone all day
quiz.explain: Exercise builds strong muscles and bones and also lifts the mood.
quiz.mistake: Does not link exercise with health

teach.ask: Gappu is growing up fast! What should Gappu do every day to stay clean and healthy?
teach.praise: Chirp chirp! Clean body, healthy food, play and sleep. Gappu is growing up strong!
teach.nudge: What kind of food does a growing body need?

learn.hook: One moment you feel on top of the world, the next you are upset over a small thing. Sound familiar? Your brain is growing up too!
points: During adolescence, feelings can change quickly. Mood swings are common and normal.
Teenagers want more independence and care a lot about what friends think.
Peer pressure is when friends push you to do something. Good friends respect your 'no'.
Say no to tobacco, alcohol and drugs. They harm the growing body and brain.
When worried or sad, talk to a trusted adult: a parent, a teacher or a school counsellor. Hobbies, exercise, enough sleep and time with family also help.

example.q: Some older students tell Rohan that he will be 'cool' if he tries chewing gutkha. What should he do?
steps: Gutkha contains tobacco, which is harmful and addictive.
Real friends do not force you to do harmful things.
He can say 'no' firmly, walk away, and tell a trusted adult.
example.answer: He should say no firmly, move away from the group and talk to a trusted adult.

learn.reallife: Many schools have counsellors and wellness clubs so students can talk about stress, exams and friendships.

games.title: Healthy or unhealthy way to handle feelings?
items: Talking to a parent or teacher
Writing in a diary
Playing a sport
Taking deep breaths when angry
Bottling up all feelings
Trying tobacco because friends do
Hurting others when angry
Staying up all night on a phone

games.title: Feelings check
items: Mood swings are common during adolescence.
Changing hormones and new situations can make feelings change quickly.
Asking for help when you feel sad is a sign of weakness.
Asking for help is a smart and brave choice.
A good friend respects it when you say no.
Real friendship does not need you to do things that are harmful.
Tobacco is safe if you try it only once.
Tobacco is harmful and addictive; even trying it can lead to a habit.

quiz.q: What are mood swings?
options: An illness that must be cured
quiz.explain: In adolescence, feelings can change fast. This is common and usually settles with time.
quiz.mistake: Thinks mood swings are a disease

quiz.q: What is peer pressure?
options: Feeling pushed by friends to do something
quiz.explain: Peers are people of your age group. Their push to act a certain way is peer pressure.
quiz.mistake: Confuses the meaning of 'peer'

quiz.q: Friends ask Tara to bunk class. What is a healthy response?
quiz.explain: Saying no to harmful choices shows confidence. Good friends will accept it.
quiz.mistake: Thinks fitting in matters more than making safe choices

quiz.q: Who is a good person to talk to about worries?
options: A trusted adult like a parent, teacher or counsellor
quiz.explain: Trusted adults can listen and help. Strangers online may not be safe.
quiz.mistake: Thinks it is better to keep worries hidden

quiz.q: Why should adolescents avoid tobacco, alcohol and drugs?
options: They harm the body and brain and are addictive
quiz.explain: These substances damage health and are hard to stop once started.
quiz.mistake: Believes harmful substances give benefits

quiz.q: Which activity can help reduce stress?
options: Playing a sport or doing a hobby
quiz.explain: Exercise and hobbies relax the mind and improve mood.
quiz.mistake: Does not know healthy ways to manage stress

quiz.q: Why do teenagers often want more independence?
options: It is a normal part of growing up
It is a sign of illness
It happens only to naughty children
quiz.explain: Wanting to decide things for yourself is a natural part of becoming an adult.
quiz.mistake: Sees a normal feeling as bad behaviour

quiz.q: Ishaan feels sad for many days and does not want to play. What should he do?
options: Talk to a trusted adult about it
Stay alone in his room forever
quiz.explain: Sharing feelings with a parent, teacher or counsellor helps. They can find more help if needed.
quiz.mistake: Thinks feelings should always be kept secret

teach.ask: Gappu feels happy one minute and grumpy the next, and a friend is pushing Gappu to do something silly. What should Gappu do?
teach.praise: Tweet tweet! Mood swings are normal, saying no is brave, and talking helps. Gappu feels much better!
teach.nudge: Who can Gappu talk to when feeling upset?
